verdict.rationale: Decagon's Insights & Reporting lets leaders run open-ended analysis across customer conversations and use heatmaps to spot spikes or dips in key metrics. Watchtower reviews every interaction against custom criteria and surfaces what matters. However, nothing documents automatic topic clustering or proactive detection of emerging issues before volume spikes; heatmaps reveal spikes rather than anticipate them, and Watchtower depends on user-defined criteria. Missing for 10: explicit automatic topic clustering of conversations, early-warning detection of emerging product issues ahead of volume spikes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, the platform clusters conversations by topic and surfaces emerging product issues before they spike ticket volume

citations.quote: Ask open-ended questions like “Why are customers requesting refunds?” to instantly analyze customer conversations.
Quickly identify spikes or dips in key metrics.
Watchtower reviews every interaction against your custom criteria and surfaces what matters most.
Ask AI powers deeper analysis through flexible, conversational queries.
